title: nan
authors: Karimi M.; Oelsch M.; Stengel O.; Babaians E.; Steinbach E.
key_contribution: Presents LoLa-SLAM, a low-latency LiDAR SLAM framework using scan slicing and concurrent matching for real-time 6D pose estimation in indoor UAV navigation, evaluated with ground-truth validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
